title: Kure Bazaar launches Biogel Keratine, a clean semi-permanent gel for professionals
summary: Once again, Kure Bazaar steps forward as a pioneer in biosourced formulas in the nail polish segment. The brand has unveiled Biogel Keratine, the first semi-permanent gel free from any controversial ingredients. Although mainly designed for professionals, the product is also for sale in stores. Biogel Keratine both lasts three to four weeks and offers a nail care action.
